images.joke: (no words: he ends up in the trash alley)

images.name: expectations
images.note: Reality panel showed him crashing upside down; the rig cannot flip, so he brakes hard on the squiggle.
images.alt: Two panels. "EXPECTATIONS": cartoon Gravel God rides a straight line up to a can of Miller Lite. "REALITY": he brakes hard, wide-eyed, on a wildly squiggly line to the same can.
